label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
Rick, I need to say this plainly so it doesn’t sit until Thanksgiving. I’m pissed, and I need you to hear why. You told Gary Pruitt I’d list his 4-bedroom in Chandler off Ray Road for 1%—a “family rate”—without asking me, and he wants to sell before spring. My listing side is 2.5%. I have never quoted 1% to anybody. You promised him my time and my rate like they were yours to give.

I spent Saturday, Nov. 7 pulling comps, doing the walkthrough, and printing a full listing packet. That was about six hours plus the drive down from north Phoenix. Gary texted Sunday night that he’s going with ListLite flat fee, $3,995, “no hard feelings.” When I called you, you said, “That’s business, sis, can’t win ’em all.” That’s what really got me.

Then this morning you text that Denise wants to “pick my brain” about her rental and you already gave her my cell. I’m not calling Denise. You can tell her.

This is the same thing as your softball guy two years ago. I let that one go. I’m not letting this go. You get to look like the big shot with your friends while I do the work for free. I’m your sister, but I’m also running a business.

I’m happy to help family—Mom, your kids, anybody—with advice, no charge. But no more handing out my number or quoting my commission. Ask me first. Every time. If you want to refer me to someone, ask me first and let me decide what I’ll charge.

I’m not mad at Gary. I’m mad at you. I’m still coming to Thanksgiving at your place and I’ll sit across from you, but this stops now.
